method.display: fresh Xvfb per application per run, 1920x1200x24, requested 96 DPI
method.rendering: LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1; software X11 in Xvfb, no native compositor
method.run_order: one run per configuration each repetition; starting configuration rotates by one each repetition
method.kitty_default: -c NONE with shared font/geometry/X11 settings; timing options use installed Kitty defaults
method.roundtrip: 100 warmups + 1000 requests, child/PTY/terminal/PTY/child; includes Python probe overhead; DSR is not a frame-completion barrier
scope_limits: RSS/PSS, X server delta, XRes bytes, and pixel estimate are separate accounts; do not blindly sum shared mappings
Ghostty is not measured by this runner

runs.font_note: Fontconfig match is a requested-font resolution; observed files are mapped/open font files in this application, including fallbacks.
runs.process_memory_scope: application PID only, excludes the Python PTY child and X server; RSS is not total terminal memory

idle_cpu.resolution_note: Zero ticks means below /proc clock-tick resolution during this sample, not a universal zero-CPU guarantee.

xserver_memory.scope: fresh Xvfb process delta; includes server caches and allocations beyond pixmaps

xres_pixmap.scope: server PIXMAP resources attributed to the window's X client; not total GPU/driver/font memory

pixel_surface_estimate.scope: estimate for one 32-bit pixel surface, not measured allocation or total graphics memory

pty_roundtrip_us.scope: child write, PTY, logical terminal state, response, PTY, child read; DSR does not wait for rendered frames or scanout
